evidence: Al2O3 ALD films with thicknesses of 1 – 26 nm were grown at 100– 175 ° C. For Al 2O3 ALD films with thicknesses /H333565 nm, oxygen transmission rates were below the MOCON instrument test limit of /H110115 /H1100310−3 cc/ m2 / day. Applying a more sensitive radioactive tracer method, H 2O-vapor transmission rates of /H110111 /H1100310−3 g/m 2 / day were measured for single-sided Al 2O3 ALD films with thicknesses of 26 nm on the polymers.
